metadata.description: Free Claude skills and kits for medical aesthetics practices.

plugins.name: price-your-treatment-menu
plugins.description: Drop in your menu, invoices, membership and overhead; get your true cost per treatment, recommended prices, a member margin check and a draft menu.

plugins.name: where-is-my-med-spa-losing-money
plugins.description: Drop in last month's reports; see which leak costs your med spa the most and get a 30-day plan to fix it.

plugins.name: find-your-medical-director
plugins.description: Prepare for, compare and vet medical director candidates, spot red flags, and write a brief for your healthcare attorney. US, not legal advice.

plugins.name: ad-claim-check
plugins.description: Screen US aesthetics ads, captions, web pages and review replies for what the FTC, FDA, state boards, Meta or Google might flag, and get rewrites.

plugins.name: claim-your-practice-in-chatgpt
plugins.description: See what ChatGPT and other AI assistants say about your practice, claim your ChatGPT Business Hub listing, fix wrong details, and track mentions monthly.

plugins.name: build-your-claude-dashboard
plugins.description: Start with five KPIs, export the right reports, take out patient information, and build, share and refresh a monthly KPI dashboard in Claude, step by step.

plugins.name: hipaa-safe-review-replies
plugins.description: Draft replies to Google and Yelp reviews in your practice's voice that never confirm someone is a patient or mention their care, and flag the ones to take offline.

plugins.name: lapsed-patient-win-back
plugins.description: Bring patients back, starting with the ones who already paid: expiring packages, unused treatments and membership balances, then lapsed patients. Template emails and texts with your branding and provider names, a tracker, and consent rules built in.

plugins.name: claude-ready-practice-kit
plugins.description: Set up five Claude Projects for your practice (front desk, marketing, finance, hiring, operations): what files to add, which connectors to turn on, and what to leave out.

plugins.name: build-your-provider-pay-plan
plugins.description: Build a pay plan and offer for an injector, esthetician or wellness provider: a market base rate, a KPI bonus that rewards rebooking, consults, memberships and reviews, and retention extras like continuing education, with the cost checked in code.
